works.title: My Work
works.subtitle: Projects and templates I've built
works.spotlight_summary: A Nuxt 4 web app deployed on Cloudflare Workers and backed by Neon Postgres.
works.spotlight_architecture: Architecture: Nitro-generated Wrangler config → Worker → Hyperdrive → Neon Postgres; Better Auth + Drizzle.
works.spotlight_lesson: Migrations use the direct, unpooled database URL; Worker runtime traffic uses Hyperdrive. The Better Auth rate_limit.id schema mismatch was fixed before deployment.
works.spotlight_checks: App routes and a separate Neon hello Function were smoke-tested. The private assets bucket is provisioned separately and is not an app runtime dependency.
works.reduced_motion_notice: Automatic slide changes are unavailable while reduced motion is enabled.
